summary: Two men from Florida on their first mountain experience took an Uber to Molas Pass (~11,000 ft) with mountain bikes intending to ride 200+ miles of backcountry to Moab; one day and ~20 miles in they gave up and called search and rescue for help
location: Molas Pass, US-550 south of Silverton
notes: Date approximate: 2021-07-11 (Sunday); Telegraph article published 2021-07-15 says 'just this past weekend'. Molas Pass is in San Juan County; call reported by LPCSAR president Ron Corkish. No injuries. Same Telegraph article as id 3185 (Cascade Creek waterfall jumps).
